done.what: Phone library cards (≤767): the name row wraps, so a chip (Default · Studio default · Terms · Proposed) drops under the name when both don't fit; names break with overflow-wrap:break-word (never mid-word, e.g. 'Def / au…'). Checked on the real build (3026, CSS swapped in) at 390 and 320 touch: 'Default: 10/30/30/30', 'Default Quote PDF', 'Terms and Conditions for…' read at the card's width.

Phone library toolbar rebuilt as two groups (scopes = to-do chips + the pill; tools). ≥768 both are display:contents, so tablet and desktop are unchanged. ≤767 the scope sits at the left and the tools at the right (the listing's phone toolbar); New Folder leaves the bar and becomes the last row of New ▾ (greyed with the rule for members who may not make folders; it stays in the bar when New ▾ is closed to the member); when the groups can't share the width (320 with a proposal waiting) the tools move to the next line whole, right-aligned. The open search takes its own full line under the tools on phones (before it got 0–33px, and at 320 the to-do chip was pushed off the left edge). Nothing leaves the screen at 390/375/320. The gallery ghost mirrors the groups.
Inside a folder at ≤1024 the crumb always takes its own line (search open or not) and the tools sit under it at the right — no more 'All de… / Showroo…' at 768 touch.

Tablet (768–1024) with the search open: the to-do chip steps aside as the library's name does (its narrowing still shows on the pill and in the pill's menu) — the Price book's box grows from ~89px to ~250px of input at 768.

Found while checking every width: at 1025 the Price book title 'My Items' was squeezed to 7px and Templates › Quotes wrapped its tools to the LEFT. From 1025 up the name keeps its width and a crowded cluster takes the next line at the right; 1280 and 1440 positions are unchanged (measured on the real build with the CSS swapped).

Deleted sheets: a refused row's reason wraps whole under the name and the row grows to it (row data-why → height auto, min 60) — 'Only Dane, an Owner or an Admin can restore this design or delete it for good' reads in full at 1440.

Deleted sheets' kind column and usage column size to their words up to 200 (fit-content(200px)); the stylesheet's default template and the TSX's declared tracks are now the same list, so an untouched sheet and a dragged one agree. 'Countertops', 'Never published', 'Not on a quote yet' read whole (real build: Version 148px with 'Never published').

Deleted sheets as cards (≤767 and touch ≤1024): the table's cell rules are gone (no hairline above the name, between name and facts, under them, or the stub by the checkbox); one rule parts each card from the next.

Brand kit colour swatches are 48×48 — the outlined field's own box — so swatch and field read as one control (real build: both 48 tall, tops equal). The Materials dialog's swatch row now aligns to the field's top too, so it keeps its place when the colour's error shows.

GhostSheet takes `l1`, which puts the page header's marker (data-om-l1-header) on the ghost, so the ≤767 top bar and dock stay while a level-1 loading.tsx shows and the page no longer drops 60px. Marked: VisualizerHomeGhost, MaterialsGhost (unless opened with ?from= — the L2 header), LeadsSkeleton (default l1 — the listing, Tasks, Tools › Quotes and Contracts), QanvastSkeleton, SettingsSkeleton. ImportsSkeleton and every L2/editor ghost stay unmarked. CompanySkeleton, the kanban ghost, X-Ray's setup ghost and Insights' loading.tsx are other packages' files — see crossFileRequests.

E4: on phones (≤767) the Maison AI button slides off the bottom edge and fades while the page scrolls down, and returns on scroll up or when the page stops at its end (or its top); a tucked button takes no press; a button holding keyboard focus stays; it follows a rotation across 767; reduced motion makes it instant (transition-property none). One component, so every page with the FAB (shell and editors) gets it; the fixed app frames (the Visualizer editor) never scroll the window, so their FAB stays. Harness: tucked on scroll down, back on scroll up and at the end, untouched at 768/1440, instant with reduced motion.

E5: LibraryItem takes an optional `editedBy`; the card foot reads 'edited … by {editedBy ?? author}'. Materials rows carry the server's editedBy through toRow, so Dane's edit of Sarah's material reads 'edited just now by Dane'; libraries without editedBy are unchanged.

Materials Filters keeps its three groups; the Price book group is 'Price book link: Any · Linked · Not linked' (LibraryFacet gets an optional `any` label; the others keep 'Any category' / 'Any finish').

Gallery side of E7: a new client module refusal.ts (Refused · settle · newIdOf · reasonOf; re-exported by library-gallery). Every create / duplicate in the template galleries (Quotes, Contracts, Tasks, T&Cs & Notes, Payments) reads the new id through newIdOf and says the rule on a refusal ('Couldn’t create the template — only …'), never opening '/templates/[object Object]'; Add to a lead, New contract from this template, From a contract read the answer the same way; the Price book's save / approve / send back / duplicate / import / bulk change / undo / delete / restore settle every answer; the folder actions in LibraryGallery (move, delete, bulk delete, undo, create in the Move dialog) treat { error } as a failure with its rule; the Move dialog's create-folder failure says the thrown rule; the brand kit and the profile's saveBrand saves say the rule instead of 'saved'. LibraryGallery's own onX props were already settled.

Materials' delete confirm and Delete Forever note split the server's renderedIn / waitingIn: 'Used in 2 designs — their renders keep it.' only for rendered designs; 'Picked in 1 design, not rendered yet — the pick comes back if you restore it from Deleted Materials.' for a waiting pick; both said together when both apply; Delete Forever says a waiting pick 'won’t come back'.

Part (3) only: the material's Edit dialog says where it is used as its subtitle — 'Used in 2 designs, and picked in 1 more. Renders already made keep it as it was; a change here reaches the next Generate.' / 'Picked in 1 design, not rendered yet. A change here reaches its first render.'; read-only viewers get the first sentence only. Parts (1) and (2) are the editor's panels (rail package).

Landing card line follows the Kind pill: under Kind: Personal it drops 'Personal' ('Showroom ideas · 2 rooms · 5 renders' now fits), under Leads it keeps the stage ('Met · 2 rooms · 5 renders'), under All it is as before. LibraryGallery passes `{ filter }` to meta. The 320 editor top-bar cut is the editor package's (topbar.module.css).

notDone.why: Server's files: the folder rule naming its maker (folderChangeBlockFor in lib/company/folder-libraries.ts) and a lead design's rule reading 'can delete this' (lib/visualizer/policy.ts / queries.ts mayChange). The gallery shows whatever mayChange says, once, under the last row it greys — no gallery change needed.

Parts (1) 'Now' tag on the kept finish and (2) 'renamed and recoloured since' live in components/visualizer/editor/panels/surfaces-panel.tsx and material-picker.tsx (rail package). Part (3) done here.
The remaining half — the editor's top bar cutting 'Design · 26 Sep (2)' at 320 — is components/visualizer/editor/topbar.module.css (editor package).

Partly by design of the owner's call E4: at first paint (before any scroll) the FAB can still rest over a card's corner chip on a short phone; it slides away as soon as the page scrolls. No keep-out was added to the grid.
